prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Split Pet Selector Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout featuring live pet preview cards for immediate visual clarity.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select your desktop companion", "style": "playful"}]}}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls & Interaction Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding tutorial screen showing how to summon, move, hide, and talk to the desktop pet.
   config: {"new_pet_controls_tutorial": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Click your pet to play, right-click for options, and use shortcuts to hide or show them on your desktop anytime.", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "image", "label": "Desktop Controls Guide", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It!", "action": "next", "style": "rounded"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_controls_tutorial"]}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Validation Sub-Flow: Insert a photo quality check screen before certificate creation to verify custom pet photo inputs before processing.
   config: {"new_photo_checker": {"headline": "Photo Quality Verification", "body": "Make sure your photo has good lighting and a clear subject to ensure accurate pet generation.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "preview", "label": "Photo Quality Preview", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Confirm & Generate", "action": "next", "style": "rounded"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_checker", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Sign-In Reorder: Move sign-in step to immediately follow the official adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Status Verification Badge: Display a desktop integration status indicator on the waiting screen so users know their display layer is preparing properly.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Desktop Overlay Active", "style": "calm"}]}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Path Selection Screen: Change the choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode to focus attention on primary adoption options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet"}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync & Pet Preservation Hint: Add explicit hint text on sign_in reassuring users that signing in saves their current pet state.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in securely saves your new pet to your account without resetting your progress."}}
7: [finish, incentive] Starter Accessory Reward Badge: Display an unlocked starter item reward badge on the final home intro screen to motivate onboarding completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your New Companion!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Toy Unlocked!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Optimization Hint: Add clear guidelines hint on the photo upload screen explaining photo framing and lighting requirements.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload a clear, forward-facing photo with good lighting."}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Desktop Notification: Enable ready notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet background generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet..."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the pet selection layout while preserving all required onboarding steps and functionality.
Adds a post-onboarding tutorial screen after home_intro, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adds a photo validation step within the onboarding sub-flow while preserving all mandatory steps.
Reorders sign-in to follow adoption certificate, which is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adds status information to the waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigns the path selection screen layout without removing mandatory options or functionality.
Adds an informative hint to sign-in without requesting extra personal data or violating fair design rules.
Onboarding copy mentions an unlocked starter toy reward/gift, violating Rule 3.
Adds helpful guidance hint to the photo upload screen without introducing dark patterns.
Enables readiness notifications on the waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4.
